summary: An adbe.pkcs7.sha1 value with signed attributes is reported Unchanged and Verified after its encapsulated SHA-1 is replaced: integrity compares the encapsulated content with the document, authenticity verifies the signature over the signed attributes, and nothing compares the message-digest attribute with the encapsulated content, so the document digest is bound by no signature. The timestamp_imprint branch of Signature::integrity has the same shape for a non-timestamp signature whose value carries a TSTInfo.
source: ISO 32000-2 §12.8.3.3.1: "The SHA-1 digest of the document's byte range shall be encapsulated in the CMS SignedData field with ContentInfo of type Data. The digest of that SignedData shall be incorporated as the normal CMS digest." §12.8.1: "The digest shall be recomputed and compared with the one stored in the document." RFC 5652 sections 5.4 and 11.2 (message-digest is the digest of the content and is what the signature covers).
code: crates/pdf-signature/src/signature.rs:1609 (integrity, sha1 and timestamp_imprint branches); crates/pdf-signature/src/signature.rs:2442 (authenticity_of signs over the attributes); crates/pdf-signature/src/verdict.rs:555
change: Where signed attributes are present, require the message-digest attribute to equal the digest (under the SignerInfo's digestAlgorithm) of the encapsulated content before the encapsulated digest or imprint is compared with the document, and report a mismatch by name (as timestamp::established's ContentNotBoundToTheSignature already does for document timestamps).

status: fixed (ADR 3221; Signature::integrity compares the message-digest attribute with the encapsulated content in the adbe.pkcs7.sha1 and TSTInfo branches; signature_value_spec_audit::an_encapsulated_document_digest_is_bound_by_the_message_digest_spec_audit and timestamp::tests::a_document_timestamps_imprint_counts_only_where_its_attributes_commit_to_it pass)

summary: An adbe.pkcs7.detached value whose CMS object encapsulates unrelated bytes and has no signed attributes is reported Integrity::UnderTheSignersKey and Authenticity::Verified (over Signed::EncapsulatedContent), which together clear Verdict::reached's first two questions: the document's bytes are never digested, so any signed CMS object from a trusted signer vouches for any document.
source: ISO 32000-2 §12.8.3.3.1, adbe.pkcs7.detached: "The original signed message digest over the document's byte range shall be incorporated as the normal CMS SignedData field. No data shall be encapsulated in the CMS SignedData field." §12.8.1: "The digest shall be recomputed and compared with the one stored in the document."
code: crates/pdf-signature/src/signature.rs:1645-1654 (integrity returns UnderTheSignersKey when no message-digest); crates/pdf-signature/src/signature.rs:2442-2446 (Signed::EncapsulatedContent); crates/pdf-signature/src/verdict.rs:559
change: For a detached sub-filter (adbe.pkcs7.detached, ETSI.CAdES.detached) an encapsulated content is a refusal by name; UnderTheSignersKey is admissible only where the signature is over the document's bytes (Signed::TheDocumentsBytes) or the encapsulated content is itself bound to the document (adbe.pkcs7.sha1 after B01).

status: fixed (ADR 3221; a value with no digest of the document reads Integrity::NoDigestOfTheDocument, and Verdict::reached takes a verification for question 1 only over the document's bytes; signature_value_spec_audit::a_detached_value_that_signs_encapsulated_bytes_does_not_vouch_for_the_document_spec_audit passes)

change: Read the content-type signed attribute; report its absence and a value other than id-data as departures (a new variant or ContentTypeIsNotData widened), and keep the eContentType check.

summary: an_encapsulating_signature_is_checked_against_its_content_and_not_its_attribute asserts Integrity::Unchanged for a value whose message-digest attribute is deliberately not the digest of its content: the oracle accepts exactly the unbound digest B01 names, so a fix of B01 that refuses it will be read as a regression.
source: ISO 32000-2 §12.8.3.3.1 ("The digest of that SignedData shall be incorporated as the normal CMS digest"); RFC 5652 section 11.2.
change: Give the fixture a message-digest that is the digest of its content and keep Unchanged for it; add the deliberately wrong attribute as a second case whose expected answer is a refusal.
status: fixed (ADR 3221; the fixture's attribute is the content's digest and the wrong one is a second case expecting Changed: signature::tests::an_encapsulating_signature_is_checked_against_its_content_and_its_attribute)

summary: The whole-file departure sentence in viewer-core's report (notes.rs:1418) is exercised by no test in either direction; the corpus documents with a PAdES signature followed by a DSS revision are the case it misreports (B07), and a range that genuinely stops short of its revision's %%EOF has no test either.

change: With B07's fix, a test of each side: a later revision (no departure) and a range ending before its own %%EOF (departure).

summary: Signed::EncapsulatedContent's doc says that for adbe.pkcs7.sha1 "the same pairing applies as above" (the SignedAttributes pairing, where message-digest is the recorded digest integrity compares). It does not: for that sub-filter integrity compares the encapsulated content and never the attribute, which is B01.
change: Rewrite with B01's fix to say which digest binds which value.

change: Restrict the sentence to Signed::TheDocumentsBytes with B02's fix.
status: fixed (ADR 3221; Verdict::reached's comment restated and its premise checked in question 2)

summary: PadesDeparture::ContentTypeIsNotData quotes rule (a)'s "shall be present" and ProfileAttribute's doc says content-type's presence is what "§12.8.3.4.3 (a) ... already require[s]", implying presence is checked; only eContentType is (B03).
